name: New Jersey Youth Corps
org: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development
city: New Jersey (local sites across the state)
what_you_do: Work in crews of 6 to 10 on community service and conservation projects. You spend about half your time on school work. It goes toward a diploma or equivalent.
who_can_apply: Young adults ages 16 to 25 who do not have a high school diploma.
pay_detail: Corpsmembers get a stipend while enrolled. The amount is not stated on the state page.
duration: Full time, year-round program; length of each cohort is not stated on the state page
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The program is described as year-round.
how_to_apply: Send the online services request form on the NJ Department of Labor page for general questions. The state page does not list sign-up steps, so ask for the site that serves your county.
notes: For teens 16 and up who left school without a diploma. Not for students still working toward a diploma in a regular school. It includes help getting a high school equivalency diploma or an adult high school diploma. It includes counseling and help moving on to college or jobs. Paid work for people under 18 in New Jersey needs working papers (online). See permit.html?state=nj for the exact permit and steps.
